games.title: Justice Dance
games.description: Use the shared movement engine for rhythm and dance drills.
games.objective: Match timing, repetition consistency, and movement quality.

games.title: Target Grid
games.description: Enter the highlighted zone with your body midpoint.
games.objective: Reach each target accurately and quickly.

games.title: Mirror Mode
games.description: Follow the reference movement with stable body position.
games.objective: Keep the replayed movement inside the pose tolerance.

games.title: Follow the Path
games.description: Trace a smooth target path with your torso midpoint.

games.title: Reaction Targets
games.objective: Reduce reaction time while preserving accuracy.

games.title: Freeze Pose
games.description: Hold a reference pose inside a tolerance range.
games.objective: Maintain a stable pose for the full interval.

games.title: Avoid the Zone
games.description: Stay away from the highlighted danger zone.
games.objective: Avoid the target while keeping controlled movement.

games.title: Rhythm Movement
games.description: Match movement timing to a repeating visual rhythm.
games.objective: Improve tempo consistency and repetition timing.

games.title: Obstacle Dodge
games.description: Avoid incoming virtual obstacles with directional movement.
games.objective: React early and stay inside safe movement limits.

games.title: Color Sequence
games.description: Visit highlighted zones in a changing sequence.
games.objective: Combine memory, reaction, and body control.

games.title: Balance Challenge
games.description: Keep the body midpoint controlled while targets change.
games.objective: Minimize sway and maintain a safe center region.

games.title: Partner Sync
games.description: Compare a movement replay against a synchronized partner target.

games.title: Sports Reaction
games.description: Use directional reach and stance changes in a sports-style drill.

games.title: Rehabilitation Lab
games.description: Review controlled range-of-motion and stability tasks.

games.title: Ergonomics Lab
games.description: Review posture, bending, reaching, and repetitive movement quality.
games.objective: Identify safer and more consistent movement patterns.

games.title: Gait and Locomotion
games.description: Review walking symmetry, transitions, and movement stability.
games.objective: Compare stride consistency and balance over time.
